status: Builder read-only repair proposal; implementation not yet released
proposal:
Read-only repair design is concrete. I will add a pure, state-aware `validateRemotePublicationRecord(record)` in authorized `state.mjs`, imported by both integration.mjs and current-pm.mjs, avoiding the current-pm↔integration cycle. It will accept legal partial envelopes but, for each present stage, validate identified objects/cross-links: required source slots and effect→stable attempt→observed result; source proof→merge effect/repository/PR/method/C/M; integration evidence commit/branch/snapshot, identified PASS gates, review, verification and exact finalization identities; closure checkout/artifact parent chain and write hashes/modes, publication proof/result; repair attempt/H2/publication/proof; completion target/branch/status and exact terminal provenance. `current-pm` then adds repository/path binding and Git checks: completed target exists, is ancestor of local HEAD, and retained terminal story/handoff entries at that target match exact bytes/hash/mode. Malformed or incomplete terminal chains stay UNKNOWN. Claim repeats the same admission check inside the transaction before any story write.
Provider identity plan: make attempt identity derive only from its immutable header; transitions retain their own append-only previous-identity chain. Supersession uses identified reciprocal link objects: successor names predecessor token+attempt identity+retained effect identity+proof identity, predecessor gets an identified successor link excluded from the stable attempt identity, and validation requires both directions. Add append-only effect history so replacing current effect after successor success never loses the predecessor effect; every effect binds a retained stable attempt identity and exact observed result identity.
Closure and repair will use the same private durable attempt engine/slot resolver as source. Every repeated publish/reconcile first settles an executing token read-only. Exact effect is adopted. Fresh-process loss plus absence remains PROVIDER_UNKNOWN. Same-process known-ended + exact PR_ABSENT appends a prepared replay transition on the same token and returns PROVIDER_REPLAYABLE. MERGE_PENDING is never absence/replay; it remains pending/read-only unless exact MERGED is adopted. Repair will no longer allocate over an executing token.
Other fixes: anchor rebase proof at retained premerge remote-base observation and inspect the whole bounded first-parent range; compare raced P/E/H preimages and H output using Git entry mode+OID as well as bytes; retain/verify H2 checkout protected ignored proof; reject H prepare under the record lock before pending/file writes unless E is adopted; resume an existing H2 prepared token when live H equals retained before or after image, applying only the retained after image; refuse drift. No public CLI/signature/state vocabulary changes appear necessary. I am ready and will hold edits/tests until regression hashes and implementation release.
